grammar.label: polite requests with would
grammar.form: Would you…? Would you mind + -ing? I would like…

explanation.en: 'Would you mind opening the window?' asks politely. Answering 'No' means yes, go ahead.
explanation.uz: 'Would you mind…?' — muloyim so'rov. Bunga 'No' javobi 'ha, marhamat' degani — bu chalkashtiriladi.

grammar.positive_example: Would you mind opening the window?
grammar.negative_example: Would you mind to open the window?

l1_notes.uz: 'Would you mind' dan keyin '-ing' keladi. Javobga e'tibor bering: 'No, not at all' = roziman.

grammar.label: shall for offers and suggestions
grammar.meaning: offering to do something or suggesting it together

explanation.en: 'Shall I…?' offers help. 'Shall we…?' suggests doing something together.
explanation.uz: 'Shall I…?' — yordam taklif qilish. 'Shall we…?' — birga qilishni taklif qilish.

grammar.negative_example: Shall I to open the window?

grammar.label: some / any / no / none and their compounds
grammar.form: something, anything, nothing, someone, somebody, anyone, anybody, no one, nobody, somewhere, anywhere, nowhere

explanation.en: some- in positives and offers; any- in negatives and questions; no- carries its own negative.
explanation.uz: some- tasdiqda va taklifda; any- inkorda va savolda; no- o'zi inkor — yana 'not' qo'shilmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: There is nothing in the bag.
grammar.negative_example: There isn't nothing in the bag.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek va rus tillarida ikki marta inkor normal, ingliz tilida esa NOTO'G'RI.
